question: 2013 年按分支统计佣金收入超过 1000 万的分支，列出前 5 名
expected_sql: SELECT db.Branch AS branch, SUM(ft.Commission) AS commission_revenue FROM atlas.dwd.fact_trades ft JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_date dd ON ft.SK_CreateDateID = dd.SK_DateID JOIN atlas.dwd.dim_broker db ON ft.SK_BrokerID = db.SK_BrokerID WHERE dd.CalendarYearID = 2013 GROUP BY db.Branch HAVING SUM(ft.Commission) > 10000000 ORDER BY commission_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

fibo_concepts.note: 度量阈值载体（HAVING 语义）
营业部/分支是组织的子单元（OMG Commons）
